text:
Anya: Quick sync — Sales pushed for region-based rollout that flips on when region usage exceeds X. Need product + eng decision on gating triggers and rollback policy. TL;DR: customers in EU want earlier access but we only want to open if latency < 120ms and error rate < 0.5%.

Mike: We can gate by aggregated p50/p99 + error rate, but need to agree on sampling window and smoothing. Short windows are noisy.

Sophia: Ops: prefer safety by staged warmup: 1% -> 5% -> 25% -> 100% with 30m bake each, auto-rollback if errors spike >0.5% in any window. Also require capacity headroom and a manual kill-switch.

Devin: I can add signals: region_token_rate, p50_latency, infra_cpu_spike. Proposed rule: usage_trigger when tokens_1h > 200k AND p50 < 120ms for 1h. Use moving averages to avoid flaps.

Carlos: Support note — a couple of enterprise customers want opt-in before full roll. Can we offer per-account early opt-in without opening global gates?

Anya: Yes, per-account opt-in is fine but we need routing + billing backfill. Also decide on SLA language and who owns comms.

Mike: Implementation sketch — feature flag config (pseudo):
```
flag: regional_rollout_eu {
  buckets: ["optin", "staged"],
  staged_schedule: [1,5,25,100],
  bake_minutes: 30,
  monitoring: { p50_threshold_ms: 120, error_threshold_ratio: 0.005 }
}
```
We should run a shadow canary for 1h before first 1% flip. Need kill-switch endpoint /api/rollout/kill.

Sophia: On-call asks: add alerts rollout.ec2.error_spike and rollout.latency_drift. Ops-bot will deploy alert rules and a runbook.

ops-bot: Created alert rules -> https://pagerduty.example/rollouts/1750012345 (rule ids: 5492, 5493) :white_check_mark:

Anya: Decision summary: agree on metrics and staged schedule. Action items: Mike implement flag + canary job by EOD Thu; Devin add dashboard + anomaly detection; Sophia run capacity warmup test and set alerts; Carlos prepare opt-in comms and support playbook. Any objections?

Mike: :thumbsup: no objections.

Devin: I'll add a dashboard with 1h moving averages + slack webhook for 2x stdev anomalies.

Carlos: Drafting customer email and support playbook now, will share by tomorrow.

Anya: I'll sync with Sales for opt-in list and update the rollout doc in the handbook. Closing here, will post the doc link when ready. :rocket:
